ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels on the fluke surface, approximately 98:2. The surface is nearly saturated black.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid contiguous black geometric mass across 98% of the visible fluke area. Minimal, isolated high-intensity (white) pixel clusters are located exclusively at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 155 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 12 pixels relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the central trailing edge. Transition to high-amplitude, irregular pixel variations (ragged edges) on the distal 15% of the left lobe's trailing edge. The right lobe distal edge shows more uniform, smaller-scale serration peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve fitted to both lobes, following a symmetric parabolic trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 4-6 localized white pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) at the distal tip of the right lobe and 2 clusters at the distal tip of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical trauma manifested as an irregular, 'chewed' or missing tissue section on the distal terminus of the left fluke lobe, resulting in an asymmetrical pixel contour compared to the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme binarization of pixel data resulting in a silhouetted effect, causing a total loss of internal grayscale texture and mid-tone gradient information.
